**Verdict: refuse. Do not buy at any size.**

- **Drawdown of 62.6% from the 30-minute high** with a flat 15-minute return and net flow of only +6.6 SOL on about $74k volume. Sell-to-buy ratio in the first two minutes after graduation was 0.99, meaning early buyers were largely exiting into the same flow.
- **Launch bot present** and 2-minute buy flow of 175 SOL from 292 buyers, a pattern consistent with the early-sniping churn that precedes distribution.
- **Shallow pool (78.5 SOL)** means a $20 ticket plus a 1.4-5.1% round trip carries heavy slippage, and a 20-50% stop would fill far below its trigger.
- Classified ORGANIC, but the classification doesn't offset a broken curve; the base rate for a random buy here is roughly -20% before any further decline.

If the desk insists on a probe despite this: $5 maximum, 20% hard stop, 15-minute hold, and only if net flow turns clearly positive on fresh volume. I would still advise skipping.

What argues against: the drawdown from the 30-minute high is 62.6%, and the last 15 minutes show net flow of just +6.6 SOL on roughly 310 SOL of buying, with sell-to-buy near 1.0 in the first two minutes after graduation. Bundle share is 30%, a launch bot is present, and the book is thin at 78 SOL of depth. Sellers are nearly as numerous as buyers. That pattern looks like demand that has already been absorbed, not demand that will persist.

A $20 entry with a 1.4-5.1% round trip also needs a meaningful rebound just to break even, and the buyback-style dip-recovery case is exactly what most coins fail to deliver. I see no honest case that real demand will still be here in 30-60 minutes. Skip.
